title: 完结感言第1549章 太上大结局
lines: 二零二二年，刚开始写这本小说的时候，我没有期待过它能取得什么样的成绩，最开始只是想着模仿神秘复苏，有个几百首订够让我赚一些钱来贴补家用就好。
但在初开始的时候，我依旧是很用心地对待了这本书的。
往往是我写完几章，就会先拿给我的第一个读者-我的老婆来看，她觉得很好，我也觉得不错的时候，我就觉得这本书应该还可以。
其实我从前还是一个比较狂妄的人，用那句电影台词里的说法，大抵就是我觉得在座的各位都是垃圾。
只有我是最牛逼的。
当然，在扑街了很多次以后，我已经在表面上不会说这种话了。
已经学会恭敬地趴在地上，对每一个成绩闪闪发光的作者道一声膜拜大佬。
而那个时候，我的内心里其实还是觉得——我应该或许还是……可以的吧？
在这本书以前，我失败了很久，我没有成功过。
这件事就像你玩古董瓷器一样，你没有见过老的瓷器是甚么样子的，老瓷器的模样就只存在于你想象之中。
这样就会形成‘每天上一当，当当不一样’的恶性循环。
套用到网罗小说里，其实就是你不知道通往成功是条甚么样的路径，你只能一遍一遍试错，这条路走不通，那就走下一条，下一条路走不通，那就走下下一条——但是，失败的道路有万千条，而通往成功的道路，可能只有那一条。
这样试错下去，什么时候是个头？
还好，我的运气还不错，在许多次的试错中，似乎逐渐走近了对的路径。
写这本书以前，我完全无法确定我自己所有的东西里，哪些是为读者所喜欢的，哪些又是为读者所不喜的，哪些是读者理解不来但也可以勉强接受的，写过这本书以后，我大概明白了一些。
那些被读者喜欢的东西，是我在网络小说、商业化写作领域里的‘特长’，那些不被读者所喜欢的东西，它并不一定就是错的，但显然可以说是我在商业化写作这个领域里的短板与缺点。
所以感谢大家不论是正面还是反面的反馈。
在这里罗列一下本书的副本吧，大家可以依照‘非常好’、‘好’、‘一般’、‘差’、‘极差’几个档次来在对应副本下作出评论，如果能说明这样打分的理由就更好了。
其实我大概知道这几个副本在读者心里的排序高低，不过这样可以更清楚一些。
1、神打术副本
2、一入密藏域副本
3、灶王神教副本
4、东流岛副本
content_en:
When I first started writing this novel in 2022, I didn't expect what kind of results it would achieve. At first, I just wanted to imitate the mysterious recovery. Ordering a few hundred songs would be enough for me to earn some money to supplement my family income.
But at the beginning, I still treated this book very carefully.
Often after I finish writing a few chapters, I show it to my first reader, my wife. She thinks it’s good and I think it’s good too, then I think the book should be good.
In fact, I used to be a relatively arrogant person. To use the phrase from the movie, I think everyone here is rubbish.
Only I am the best.
Of course, after many attempts on the street, I no longer say such things on the surface.
I have learned to lie on the ground respectfully and say "worship" to every author who has made shining achievements.
And at that time, I actually still felt in my heart - maybe I should still... be able to do it, right?
Before this book, I had failed for a long time, and I had never succeeded.
This is like playing with antique porcelain. You have never seen what old porcelain looks like. The appearance of old porcelain only exists in your imagination.
This will form a vicious cycle of "being cheated every day, but being cheated differently".
Applied to the snare novel, the truth is that you don’t know what kind of path leads to success. You can only try and make mistakes over and over again. If this path doesn’t work, then take the next one. If the next path doesn’t work, then take the next one. However, there are thousands of paths to failure, but there may be only one path to success.
If this trial and error continues, when will it end?
Fortunately, I had good luck. After many trials and errors, I seemed to be gradually approaching the right path.
Before writing this book, I was completely unable to determine which of my own things readers liked, which readers disliked, and which readers could not understand but could reluctantly accept. After writing this book, I probably understand a little bit more.
Those things that are liked by readers are my "specialties" in the field of online novels and commercial writing. Those things that are not liked by readers are not necessarily wrong, but they can obviously be said to be my shortcomings and shortcomings in the field of commercial writing.
So thank you all for your feedback, both positive and negative.
Let’s list the copies of this book here. You can make comments under the corresponding copies according to the grades of ‘very good’, ‘good’, ‘average’, ‘poor’ and ‘extremely poor’. It would be better if you could explain the reasons for such ratings.
In fact, I roughly know the ranking of these copies in readers' minds, but this can make it clearer.
1. Copy of God's Fighting Technique
2. Entering the secret domain copy
3. Copy of Kitchen God Cult
4. Copy of Dongliu Island
